14547920637.description:
M00508. My first picure here on Flickr taken with my new Canon EOS M through a open car window in full speed (not driving). I really like the camera and it's really fun and easy to use. It's a creativity booster. I wish Canon continues with M and develops a semi-pro model. I'd like a separate AE/AF-lock button, a electronic viewfinder, a bit faster AF and a somewhat more distinct shutter-release button.

Pros:

* The touch screen is fantastic and responsive. I really miss it on my 5D. The screen is bright and could be used in day-light.
* Image quality is surprisingly good at lower ISOs (RAW)
* Size and weight
* The EF-M 22/2 is small and really sharp even at f/2

Cons:

* AF in low light
* Battery life
* Soft and un-distinct shutter release button. A bit of lag.
